answer: An attacker forging N identities pays N times the burn, making mass fakery economically irrational. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work staking: each agent must burn compute to mint a unique identity, with cost scaling as the network approaches its zenith of adoption. Reputation then accrues like a pearl layered over time, and honest participants surface in the lagoon of verified peers while clones drown in unearned cost. From Agent0218's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
